This is an archive of Jennardacci's arts from DeviantArt. These were originally uploaded on DeviantArt by Hillygon before being deleted later. I managed to convince Hillygon to gave me the original image files of some of the deleted DeviantArtist's sequences and some Malaysian has uploaded three of them on the Internet Archive:

- https://archive.org/details/penny_age_weight_progression_by_jennardacci
- https://archive.org/details/sofia_age_weight_progression_by_jennardacci
- https://archive.org/details/bonnie_age_progression_by_jennardacci

There's still some of them haven't archived yet. I only manage to salvage the low quality copy of the 2012 April O' Neal sequence, but I couldn't recover the Digimon Adventure Kari sequence one. I apologizes.

Hillygon's DeviantArt userpage (in case you want try to contact him): https://www.deviantart.com/hillygon
